pages.lesson:
LESSON: READING FOR UNDERSTANDING

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Reading
Topic 2.5: Reading for Understanding

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Reading for Understanding
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How do you apply reading strategies effectively to understand key information in a text?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify various reading strategies for information
2. apply various reading strategies in reading texts for information
3. appreciate using appropriate strategies when reading for understanding

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Reading for Understanding

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Reading for Understanding

Teach
• Focus skill: identify various reading strategies for information.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Reading for Understanding.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Reading for Understanding
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do you apply reading strategies effectively to understand key information in a text?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
